claim: The Philippine Competition Commission found a cartel of onion importers and traders split up the onion import market from 2019 to 2023, and fined six of them a record P1.76 billion.
status: Decided 1 Oct 2026; some firms asked the PCC to reconsider, and can appeal to the Court of Appeals

claim: The House agriculture committee found that an onion cartel was operating, and that traders and cold storage operators made the late-2022 shortage look worse than it was.
status: Committee finding; not a court ruling

claim: House lawmakers alleged that importers and traders colluded to keep rice prices high after the 2024 tariff cut, and estimated they gained about P13 billion from it.
status: Alleged at House hearings; no charges found

claim: A former agriculture secretary said the 20-point tariff cut went mostly to traders and importers, not to shoppers.

suspect: Spoilage on the way to market
claim: A study of Benguet vegetable farmers found that about 42% of the harvest spoils before it is sold.
source_name: Journal of Environmental Science and Management (UPLB)
